Advances: ancora.parsing

Severity: High (calibrated). Consolidated findings F4 and F23.

F4 — Ancora.Parser stores a raw string-keyed YAML map under "meta" when Zoi rejects the block (lib/ancora/parser.ex:85), but gate.ex:415, status.ex:160, review.ex:335 and change_analysis.ex:46 all read it with atom keys. Verified by running it: a spec-meta block missing one required field makes mix spec.check die with FunctionClauseError in Compare.compare/4, and spec.status, spec.next and spec.prime die with KeyError. Five of eight tasks crash. Only spec.validate survives, because Verifier/AppendOnly/Overlap read through a bilingual accessor. It fails closed, but the primary command hands a stack trace to a user who made exactly the mistake the tool exists to catch, and the correct finding it computed never surfaces.
Fix: store nil on schema-validation failure so the existing nil handling takes over, add one Ancora.Index.subject_id/1, route the four call sites through it, and filter non-binary ids before they reach Compare.compare/4. Add a regression test running every corpus-reading task against a spec whose spec-meta is missing a required field.

F23 — the same root cause produces four byte-identical copies of a String.to_existing_atom-in-a-rescue key accessor (parser.ex:234, verifier.ex:353, append_only.ex:147, overlap.ex:166, plus a fifth variant at review/html.ex:300). Exceptions as control flow in a hot accessor. Fix: move the accessor into Ancora.Index as one function built on a compile-time key map, drop the rescue, delete the copies. Note the string-keyed OUTER index shape is a deliberate semver commitment (ancora.parsing.stable_public_api) and must not change; the heterogeneous type under "meta" is the defect.

Lands with F4 as one change.

Verification:
- Tests to pass: a new regression test (test/ancora/index_test.exs or test/mix/tasks/*_test.exs) running spec.check, spec.status, spec.next, spec.prime, spec.review, and spec.validate against a corpus whose spec-meta block is missing one required field, asserting a finding line and a verdict and no crash; tagged tests under ancora.parsing (test/ancora/parser_test.exs, test/ancora/verifier_test.exs, test/ancora/append_only_test.exs, test/ancora/overlap_test.exs)
- Behaviors to demonstrate: (1) Parser stores nil under "meta" on schema failure and every reader tolerates nil; (2) one Ancora.Index.subject_id/1 (or equivalent) replaces the four atom-key reads at gate.ex, status.ex, review.ex, change_analysis.ex; (3) one compile-time key accessor in Ancora.Index replaces the four rescue-based copies plus the html.ex variant, no rescue left; (4) Compare.compare/4 never receives a non-binary id; (5) the string-keyed OUTER index shape is byte-for-byte unchanged (stable_public_api)

  - Iteration tier: mix test --stale or explicitly named test files, plus mix spec.validate; no full suite mid-iteration.
